133 likes, 4 comments - amitbhawani on September 1, 2026: "Are B by Lenskart actually SMART glasses? 👓

After using them in the real world, my favourite feature isn’t Gemini. It’s actually the camera, especially the ability to shoot hands-free landscape video.

For POV shots and B-roll, they’re genuinely useful.

But there are some big Gen-1 problems:
• Gemini feels very limited
• Battery drains surprisingly fast
• Meeting transcription wasn’t reliable for me
• Couldn’t find the original meeting audio to verify it
• Software still needs polishing
• Build feels slightly delicate for heavy outdoor use

My biggest feature request? Dashcam Mode.

Keep a rolling 3-minute video buffer while driving, but don’t save anything permanently. If something happens, simply say “Save the last 3 minutes.” Otherwise, keep overwriting it. That would be an amazing use of camera glasses.

My current verdict?

Camera glasses + audio = YES.
Truly “smart-smart” glasses = Not yet.

But the potential is definitely there.

Would you use something like this every day?".

126 likes, 3 comments - amitbhawani on August 26, 2026: "Apple’s 2026 lineup could be CRAZY! 

iPhone 18 Pro is expected with the new A20 Pro 2nm chip, variable aperture camera and a smaller Dynamic Island.

But that’s just the beginning.

Apple’s FIRST Foldable iPhone - Expected ~5.5” outer + ~7.8” folding display, with rumours even pointing towards Touch ID making a comeback.

TOUCHSCREEN MacBook Pro - Apple is reportedly working on an OLED MacBook with M6-generation chips and something it has resisted for years: a touchscreen.

AirPods WITH CAMERAS?!
Not necessarily for taking photos. The idea could be to give Siri and Visual Intelligence the ability to understand your surroundings.

Imagine looking at something and simply asking Siri, “What is this?”

The iPhone 18 Pro looks good, but the Foldable iPhone, touchscreen MacBook and camera AirPods are what could make Apple’s next generation genuinely different.

These are based on current leaks and reports and are not all officially confirmed by Apple.

Which one would you actually buy?
#Apple #iPhone18Pro #iPhoneFold #MacBookPro #AirPods AppleIntelligence iPhone18 Apple2026".

61 likes, 2 comments - amitbhawani on August 23, 2026: "I’m switching from Apple Watch to the Pixel Watch 5.

Dual-frequency GPS, surprisingly smooth gestures, comfortable sleep tracking and fast charging are all impressive.

Gemini? Useful, but I want it to become a real AI health/fitness coach.

But what I’m REALLY waiting to test are Google’s upcoming Blood Pressure Trends and Insulin Resistance Trends.

And my biggest complaint remains simple:
Why can’t Google Health and Apple Health properly talk to each other?
I should be able to wear Pixel Watch today and Apple Watch tomorrow without worrying about years of health history.

My watch can change. My health data shouldn’t. Full video on YouTube.

#PixelWatch5 #GooglePixelWatch5 #PixelWatch #AppleWatch #GooglePixel WearOS Smartwatch GoogleHealth Gemini DualFrequencyGPS".
